utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is still on for this weekend — folks are bringing tools, spare parts, and a whole lot of goodwill. If you need anything fixed, now’s the time to speak up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is it definitely still happening this weekend? I just want to make sure before I bring anything by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes — that’s what I’ve heard, and it’s still set for this weekend. I’d check with the organizer just before you head over, but it sounds like it’s on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and repeat the plan to everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. Thanks for keeping everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll make sure everyone hears the plan again at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help spread the word while I’m out running errands. What do you need me to tell folks?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just tell folks we’re collecting tools, paint, and spare parts this week. If they’ve got anything to donate, have them leave it by my porch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. If you want, I can help sort tools or spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be a big help, Rey. I can sort the tools if you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely, I’ll spread the word and let people know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around the school schedule—what time does the repair drive need us there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a huge help, Faye—thank you. I’m thinking we should aim to be there around 9:00 so we can get set up before people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:00 works for me — I’ll plan around the school drop-off and be there then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—who’s handling what, and when do we start?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry—let’s make it simple. I can handle the pickups, and we can start Saturday morning after 9.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—Saturday after 9 is fine. Just let me know the pickup list and I’ll keep my end tidy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m definitely passing that along — the repair drive sounds worth showing up for. If you want, I can help spread the word a bit faster.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be really helpful, thanks. I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got enough hands and no one gets turned around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell a few folks and make sure they know where to go. We should get a solid crew there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive coming up—what do I need to know?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—it's this Saturday at the community hall, and folks can bring small household items that need fixing. If you have anything specific, I can help you get it on the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—I've got a lamp that needs fixing, so I'll bring it by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m listening—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and what details should I double-check before we move ahead?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I don’t have any new updates yet, but I’d double-check the supply list, volunteer times, and any safety notes before we move ahead. If you want, I can help sort the details with you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, let’s sort them together—I’ll start by checking the supply list, volunteer times, and safety notes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, though I have to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — quiet help still counts. I’ll swing by late and pitch in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Come by late, and I’ll keep it discreet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my toolbox for the repair drive—just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus—could you bring the screwdriver set and the spare tape?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely—I’ll bring the screwdriver set and spare tape by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—what location are we using for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’d use the community center if it’s available.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds good—I'll check whether the community center is available for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just give me a shout when you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but we should pin down the time and drop-off details first so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the time and where we should drop everything off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s set a specific time and the exact drop-off spot before we gather anything. That way we won’t end up with confusion at the curb.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you spread the word that we’re looking for volunteers, tools, and any small appliance repairs folks want help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about volunteers, tools, and small appliance repairs. If you want, I can also help word it so it’s easy to share.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of the supplies for the repair drive. Just let me know what we need first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a little late, but I can help with that once I get there. What’s first on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: First we should check nails, tape, and a few sturdy tarps. I’ll make a quick list so we can see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice bit of traction—people are starting to chip in. If you’re thinking of helping, I’d say now’s a good time to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s good to hear. I can swing by after school pickup and drop something off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Lovely, that’ll be a big help—after school pickup should be perfect. I’ll let folks know you’re planning to drop something off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — could you help organize the sign-up sheet and see who can bring tools or lend a hand on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can take care of the sign-up sheet and ask around for tools and helpers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort donations and carry supplies? A couple hours this week would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can sort donations and help carry supplies for a couple hours this week. Just let me know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now — want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please put my name down — I’d appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted on the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive yet, but I can keep an eye on the location for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would help a lot, Opal. Please keep me posted on the location, and I’ll stick to the usual plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep watching the repair drive’s location and let you know if it moves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, what time does the repair drive start, and do you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure of the start time yet, so let me check first. If you can bring some gloves and a box cutter, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I can bring gloves and a box cutter. Just let me know the start time when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is getting moving — what do you need me to keep an eye out for while I’m out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — if you spot any spare screws, a roll of duct tape, or a working flashlight, grab them for me. And maybe keep an eye out for anyone who’s good with tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll keep an eye out for screws, duct tape, a flashlight, and any handy folks while I’m out.
